Consolidate information from project teams, health facilities, government systems, implementing partners, and other relevant sources. Review data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness; investigate discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions. Develop and implement data management procedures, validation checks, quality assurance protocols, and reporting guidance. Maintain organized, secure, and accessible datasets and documentation in accordance with MSH, donor, and applicable data protection requirements. Recommend practical improvements to data collection processes, database functionality, and information flows. Data Analysis, Visualization, and Reporting (30%) Analyze programs, health services, supply chains, and other relevant datasets to identify trends, gaps, risks, and implementation challenges. Prepare analytical summaries, presentations, and reports for project leadership, government counterparts, donors, and partners. Interpret findings and propose practical recommendations to support program planning, implementation, and resource allocation. Conduct additional or specialized analyses in response to emerging project priorities and requests. About Working In Engineering At McCain. Our manufacturing plants run around the clock producing some of the UK's most loved food products - and our engineers are the heartbeat of everything we do. From the moment potatoes arrive at our factory gates to the finished product heading out the door, our engineering teams keep every stage of that process moving safely, efficiently, and reliably. This isn't a role where you clock in, fix one thing, and clock off. Our plants are complex, fast-moving environments where no two shifts are ever the same. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, move into leadership, or explore opportunities internationally — we'll back your growth. With ambitious plans for the future, there's plenty of scope to develop your career with us. About McCain. Click here to learn more about McCain and how we provide you with opportunities to make an impact that matters. Leadership Principles. At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve results. We are customer obsessed, curious, and driven. We think big, act like owners, and bring out the best in our people. We foster trust and inclusion, create space for healthy debate, and commit to decisions together. These aren't just words on a wall — they're how we show up every day. The McCain Experience. We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Here, you'll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Join us and experience why we're better together. Ready to register your interest? Submit your CV and a brief note about the type of engineering role you're looking for and we'll be in touch when something comes up that fits. We are McCain. We recognize that inclusion drives our creativity, resilience, and success and makes our business stronger.
